406.name: 1600-1850 Soldiers Field Road
406.desc:
Trammell Crow has submitted a Letter of Intent proposing the redevelopment of 1600, 1800, and 1850 Soldiers Field Road. The proposed redevelopment is anticipated to take place in two phases, with adjacent parcels: the first phase consists of 1600 Soldiers Field Road and 15 Soldiers Field Place, and the second phase would include 1800 & 1850 Soldiers Field Road. Collectively, the development project will deliver to the community two residential buildings that will be 100% affordable at an average cost of 60% AMI, supported by three commercial buildings including
lab, office, and retail.

910.name: 1 Joslin Place Hospital
910.desc: The Project is anticipated to involve the demolition of the existing Joslin Diabetes Center Building and the construction of a new approximately 14-story building containing approximately 300 inpatient beds and 20 observation beds for Dana Farber Cancer Institute (DFCI), together with clinical support space on lower floors for Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, a below-grade inpatient imaging department for DFCI and a below-grade garage containing approximately 250 accessory vehicle parking spaces.

405.name: 1000 Washington Street
405.desc: The 2023 Project consists of alterations to the existing 11-story building at 1000 Washington Street to accommodate approximately 237,031 square feet of new life science uses.

403.name: 160 McClellan Highway
403.desc: The project will include the demolition of an existing one-story warehouse structure and the construction of a new two-story building comprising approximately 152,500 square feet of gross floor area, with anticipated uses that include warehousing, receiving and distribution, and accessory office uses, as well as off-street surface parking for approximately ten vehicles and loading dock areas which shall include 24 loading docks, including eight dedicated truck chargers to support fully electric building to airport truck transfers.

909.name: 780 American Legion Highway
909.desc: The Property consists of approximately 2.58 acres located within the Roslindale neighborhood of Boston. It is currently occupied by the Home for Little Wanderers and contains existing office and community service uses, associated surface parking, circulation areas, and landscaped open space. The Property is mapped within the Two-Family Residential ("2F-5000 ") Subdistrict of the Roslindale Neighborhood District, as well as the Greenbelt Protection Overlay District (GPOD). 400.name: 69 McGreevey Way
400.desc:
Mission Main Tenant Task Force and WinnDevelopment are partnering to develop Ward Street Senior Housing, a 110-unit, 100% deeply affordable ground-up development for seniors aged 62 and older in Boston’s Mission Hill neighborhood. Resident rents will not exceed 30% of housing income. The development will feature approximately 77 one-bedroom and 33 two-bedroom apartments and is designed to support independent living for low-income elderly households.

904.name: 79 Essex Street
904.desc: Beacon Communities is proposing the conversion of 79 Essex Street to approximately 47 units of affordable rental housing with associated amenities and minimal retail/cultural/commercial space on the ground floor.

402.name: 92 Spring Street
402.desc: The Proposed Project is to construct a new four (4) story residential building, composed of forty-four (44) residential units and accessory parking below grade at the basement level. A total of forty-four (44) parking spaces will be provided. Two existing parcels will be combined to form the project site creating a 22,890 square foot lot. The Proposed Project will be approximately 48,463 square feet in Gross Square Feet.

399.name: 185 Corey Road
399.desc: The project proposes the construction of a new five-story, 34 unit condominium building with ground floor retail, 26 vehicular parking spaces, and 40 bicycle parking spaces.

908.name: 408 South Huntington Avenue
908.desc: This project would demolish an existing 1 story commercial building to Construct a new five (5) story multifamily residential building with forty five (45) residential units, and parking for ten (10) vehicles. The Project is to include up to 8 Inclusionary Zoning ("IZ") units.

907.name: 84 Stonley Road
907.desc: The project proposes construction of a 5-story building with 28 rental units (5 of which will be affordable). The building will fill the lot along Stonley Road and Stedman Street, defining the existing street wall and creating a gateway between the two streets. The building is within walking distance of both MBTA Orange Line Forest Hills and Green Street stations, as well as MBTA bus routes along Washington Street. The project proposes no parking.

397.name: 15 State Street
397.desc: Under the Downtown Office to Residential Conversion Program, this project will convert an existing 11-story office building, with retail, to 45 residential apartment units, including 8 IZ units, with ground-floor and second-floor retail space.

906.name: 25 Tolman Street
906.desc: 25 Tolman street utilizes the footprint and height-profile of the existing structure and an ample 22,670 square foot lot to construct seventeen (17) total home-ownership units, each with its own parking space.  The units are a combination of townhouses and apartment-style units, and are spread out within three different structures, with six (6) units in the Tolman Street apartment building, and the remaining eleven (11) townhouses in the rear portion of the lot. The ground-floor commercial space will retain its long-standing retail tenant, Figaro’s sandwich shop, while repurposing unused ground-floor area into a residential lobby and additional commercial space. 398.desc: The proposed project would be constructed on an approximately 6,069 square foot site at the corner of Bromfield and Province Streets now occupied by four largely vacant and obsolete commercial buildings. Phase 1 will consist of a five-story building containing approximately 196,000 square feet of self-storage (“Warehouse”) space.
